LanguageData.LP_SizeSmall.label: small frame
LanguageData.LP_SizeSmall.description: The carrier's body is only seven tenths the size of an ordinary person: body size ×0.7 (drawn at about 0.8×). Eats less and is a smaller target, but carries less too.
LanguageData.LP_SizeSmall.customEffectDescriptions.0: Body size ×0.7 (drawn at about 0.8×); replaces the race's own body size, then multiplied by the race's small adjustment.
LanguageData.LP_SizeLarge.label: giant frame
LanguageData.LP_SizeLarge.description: The carrier grows to the size of a giant: body size ×2 (drawn at about 1.4×). Health, melee and carrying rise with body size by the giant-body rule, and so does appetite.
LanguageData.LP_SizeLarge.customEffectDescriptions.0: Body size ×2 (drawn at about 1.4×, children grow with age); replaces the race's own body size, then multiplied by the race's small adjustment.
LanguageData.LP_SizeLarge.customEffectDescriptions.1: Health ×150%, melee ×130%, carrying ×150% (giant-body rule at 100% strength); stomach capacity ×2.
LanguageData.LP_SizeHuge.label: mountain frame
LanguageData.LP_SizeHuge.description: The carrier is like a small mountain: body size ×3 (drawn at about 1.75×). Health, melee and carrying rise with body size by the giant-body rule.
LanguageData.LP_SizeHuge.customEffectDescriptions.0: Body size ×3 (drawn at about 1.75×, children grow with age); replaces the race's own body size, then multiplied by the race's small adjustment.
LanguageData.LP_SizeHuge.customEffectDescriptions.1: Health ×200%, melee ×160%, carrying ×200% (giant-body rule at 100% strength); stomach capacity ×3.
LanguageData.LP_SizeColossal.label: sky-bearing frame
LanguageData.LP_SizeColossal.description: The carrier stands tall enough to hold up the sky: body size ×4 (drawn at about 2×). Health, melee and carrying rise with body size by the giant-body rule.
LanguageData.LP_SizeColossal.customEffectDescriptions: Body size ×4 (drawn at about 2×, children grow with age); replaces the race's own body size, then multiplied by the race's small adjustment.
Health ×250%, melee ×190%, carrying ×250% (giant-body rule at 100% strength); stomach capacity ×4.
